1. (Currently amended) A method for restoring efficiency of a photovoltaic cell, the method comprising: illuminating a photovoltaic cell such that the photovoltaic cell receives a __time integrated__ irradiance equivalent to at least 5 hours of solar illumination; and annealing the photovoltaic cell at a temperature above 90 degrees Celsius for a minimum of 10 minutes, the annealing in response to illuminating the photovoltaic cell.

2. (Currently amended) The method of Claim 1, wherein the photovoltaic cell comprises a semiconductor wafer, and __wherein the photovoltaic cell receives a time integrated irradiance equivalent to at least 20 hours of solar illumination during the illuminating step__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of Claim 2, wherein the photovoltaic cell is annealed at a temperature above __130__ degrees Celsius, and wherein annealing the photovoltaic cell further comprises illuminating the photovoltaic cell.

4. (Currently amended) The method of Claim 3, wherein illuminating the photovoltaic cell while annealing __the__ photovoltaic cell is performed such that the photovoltaic cell receives a time integrated irradiance equivalent to at least 10 minutes of solar illumination.

5. (Currently amended) The method of Claim 1, wherein the __photovoltaic cell comprises a__ semiconductor wafer __that__ is a silicon semiconductor wafer.

6. (Previously presented) The method of Claim 1, wherein the photovoltaic cell is annealed at a temperature between 140 degrees Celsius and 210 degrees Celsius for a minimum of 2 hours.

7. (Previously presented) The method of Claim 6, wherein the photovoltaic cell is a thin film photovoltaic cell.

8. (Previously presented) The method of Claim 6, wherein the photovoltaic cell is an amorphous silicon thin film photovoltaic cell.

9. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the photovoltaic cell is illuminated after manufacturing of the photovoltaic cell is complete such that the photovoltaic cell produces electricity when illuminated.

10. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the photovoltaic cell is illuminated with a light source that simulates light from the sun.
